fact: The Sierra Leone Standards Bureau states that its Standards Department develops and publishes national standards under the Standards Act No. 2 of 1996, and that it has published 204 national standards in the public gazette; it names a technical committee on Information Security Management Systems but no national IT or data standard issued; published date used because the page gives no event date.

ISO's member page says the Sierra Leone Standards Bureau was created by the Standards Act No 2 of 1996 to coordinate standardization and quality management and offers development and sale of national standards.
